value.rationale: Fixing a target invariant distribution while optimizing over reversible Markov edge conductances is natural for smoothing dynamics with the same equilibrium. The theorem gives an unknown sharp and nontrivial invariant-mass-dependent amplification envelope (strictly below the diameter bound two), identifies the singular time-scale geometry attaining it only in the limit, and proves a new strict conductance monotonicity mechanism. This is a structural classification for all positive three-state birth–death generators, not a one-off numerical invariant or a routine normalized-parameter substitution. The four-rate formula is needed to motivate and verify the fixed-stationary-law optimum; no larger general theory is claimed.
